description: Knowledge matrix for The Cold Case Girl, Book 1. Tracks what each major character knows at each milestone, ensuring consistent information flow and protecting key reveals until their payoff chapters. Milestones are derived from total_chapters=38.

knows: She is the executioner who kills guilty men the system failed to punish.
Her first kill was Julian Croft (staged boating accident) — she knows the full truth.
Her sister Mara was murdered by Croft; he walked free.
Her network exists: Sasha, Priya, Wren.
She is reopening the Elise Marchetti case as her new podcast season.
Victor Rhodes is the prime suspect who walked free.
Her rule: never kill an innocent.
She has a thumb-tap tic when making decisions.
ch1.hidden_truth: None — Nadia is the protagonist; the reader knows what she knows from ch1.

knows: Everything from ch1.
Rhodes has left a voicemail with phrasing from her private notes — she suspects he knows more than he should.
Priya's signature anomaly on a recent death certificate — she worries about network exposure.
The network is operational and loyal (so far).
The podcast season is gaining traction; Elise Marchetti's family has reached out.
must_not_know_before: Rhodes's full counter-investigation (he is building a case on her first kill).
The network betrayal (not yet active).
The dead-man's-switch (not yet planted).
ch8.hidden_truth: She does not yet know Rhodes has figured out her true nature (revealed at ch10).

ch38.hidden_truth: None — all major reveals have been paid off by ch38. The third party's identity is the Book 2 hook.
